configurePresets.name: msvc
configurePresets.description: Default toolchain on Windows. Benchmarks build with /O2 pinned in tests/bench/CMakeLists.txt.

configurePresets.name: clang-cl
configurePresets.description: Separate compiler, same ABI as MSVC. Used to compare code generation between the two.

configurePresets.name: clang
configurePresets.description: LLVM clang driver. Needs the llvm-mingw or a GNU-like environment on Windows.

configurePresets.name: gcc
configurePresets.description: GCC, used on Linux and on the Raspberry Pi boards.

configurePresets.name: gcc-pi
configurePresets.description: Same as gcc, kept separate so that Pi runs are recorded under their own preset name. Expect a much smaller workload: the benchmark sizes itself from RAM and cache.

configurePresets.name: linux-clang
configurePresets.description: The clang configuration CI builds and tests. Put LLVM's bin directory on PATH so that clang resolves to the version the project pins; the workflow installs LLVM 22 for exactly that reason.

configurePresets.name: linux-gcc
configurePresets.description: The GCC configuration, with the tests on rather than the benchmarks: gcc-pi is the same toolchain under the preset the boards record their runs with.

configurePresets.name: linux-coverage
configurePresets.description: Source-based coverage for tools/coverage.py: the same flags as the Windows coverage preset, with clang rather than clang-cl as the driver.

configurePresets.name: linux-tidy
configurePresets.displayName: Clang on Linux, compile database (Debug, tests)
configurePresets.description: Nothing is compiled here: the configuration exists to produce compile_commands.json for clang-tidy, as the tidy preset does on Windows.

configurePresets.name: tests-only
configurePresets.description: The configuration used for ordinary development on Windows and by the Windows CI job. The compiler is pinned: a runner with MinGW on PATH otherwise configures a GNU build that is not what this preset - or the job using it - claims. Linux uses linux-clang or linux-gcc, which pin their own.

configurePresets.name: msvc-asan
configurePresets.description: The memory check on Windows. clang's ASan runtime cannot intercept here and its UBSan runtime refuses the /MD objects, so both are refused on this platform; see tools/cmake/Sanitizers.cmake.

configurePresets.name: coverage
configurePresets.description: Source-based coverage for the library: the tests run instrumented, and tools/coverage.py merges the profiles and reports with llvm-cov. MSVC cannot do this here - its coverage tool belongs to Visual Studio Enterprise.

configurePresets.name: tidy
configurePresets.description: Nothing is compiled here: this configuration exists to produce compile_commands.json, which tools/check.py feeds to clang-tidy. Running the tool through the compile database keeps it away from the MSVC frontend flags that clang-tidy cannot re-parse.
